specs.title: SCN-001: A signed-in customer adds a product to favourites and gets 201 with that product

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and a product of the catalogue
When I POST /favorites with that product_id
Then the answer is 201 with the favourite of that product

specs.title: SCN-002: Adding a product that is already a favourite again is rejected with 409 and it stays listed once

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and a product of the catalogue
When I POST /favorites with that product_id
And I POST /favorites with the same product_id again
Then the second add is rejected with 409
And GET /favorites lists that product exactly once

specs.title: SCN-003: GET /favorites answers 200 with the customer's own favourites

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with two favourite products
Then the answer is 200 and lists both my favourites

specs.title: SCN-005: In the web shop, a customer adds a product to favourites on its page and finds it on the Favorites page

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer on a product page of the web shop
Then I see "Product added to your favorites list."
And the product is listed on the "Favorites" page of my account
[SEED] look up the favourites the web shop added (GET /favorites)

specs.title: SCN-006: DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} removes the favourite with 204 and GET /favorites no longer lists it

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with a favourite product
When I DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} of that favourite
And GET /favorites no longer lists that favourite

specs.title: SCN-007: POST /favorites answers with the favourite: its id and its product id

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and a product of the catalogue
When I POST /favorites with that product_id
Then the answer carries the favourite's id and the product id

specs.title: SCN-008: GET /favorites never includes another customer's favourites

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with a favourite product
And another customer has a favourite of a product I did not add
Then the other customer's favourite is not in my list

specs.title: SCN-009: A favourite added with POST is listed by GET and removed with its id by DELETE

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and a product of the catalogue
When I POST /favorites with that product_id
Then GET /favorites lists the favourite with that id and product
When I DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} with the id POST answered
Then GET /favorites no longer lists it

specs.title: SCN-010: A product added to favourites in the web shop is in the customer's GET /favorites

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer on a product page of the web shop
When I click "Add to favourites" and the shop confirms it
Then GET /favorites, as the same customer, lists the product
[SEED] look up the favourites the web shop added (GET /favorites)
